verdict.rationale: Adyen documents public APIs for its agentic commerce product. These include the Agentic Cart API (create, commit and cancel session), the Agentic Feed API (batch product uploads of up to 200 items), and ACP/UCP agent-platform integrations that return tokens and sessions, plus webhooks. Machine-readable OpenAPI definitions are published in the official adyen-openapi GitHub repo, and the docs are available in LLM-friendly form (llms.txt and .md pages). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the agentic APIs, and no confirmation that the OpenAPI repo covers the Agentic Cart/Feed APIs specifically (the docs-domain OpenAPI paths returned 404).
